items.title: Ex-congressman George Santos banned from betting platform for life
items.dek: The prediction market operator Kalshi says Santos made barred trades and misleading comments that influenced prices.

items.title: US singer D4vd's celebrity lawyers withdraw from murder case
items.dek: The singer, 21, will be now represented by a public defender in the murder trial of 14-year-old Celeste Rivas Hernandez. He has pleaded not guilty.
